meta.name: epic-breakdown-advisor
meta.description: Break down epics into user stories with Humanizing Work split patterns. Use when a backlog item is too large to estimate, sequence, or deliver safely.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将大型史诗拆解为可交付的用户故事
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的待办项太大无法估算或交付
copy.tagline_en: Break down large epics into deliverable user stories
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your backlog items are too large to estimate or deliver

howto.what: 装上后，当用户提出一个大型需求时，Claude会引导用户做预拆分验证（INVEST检查），然后按顺序应用9种拆分模式（工作流步骤、CRUD操作、业务规则变体等），生成垂直切分、端到端价值的用户故事。
howto.when: 当用户提到的待办项过大，难以估算、排序或安全交付时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个用户注册功能拆成小故事。
say.note: Claude会引导你完成INVEST检查和模式匹配。

say.text: 这个报表功能太大，用拆分模式处理。
say.note: Claude会依次应用9种模式直到找到合适的。

say.text: 用工作流模式拆分发布流程。
say.note: Claude会生成简单的端到端切片故事。

howto.what_en: After installation, when a user presents a large epic, Claude guides them through INVEST validation and sequentially applies 9 splitting patterns (workflow steps, CRUD, business rules, etc.) to produce vertical user stories that deliver end-to-end value.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions a backlog item too large to estimate, sequence, or deliver safely.

say_en.text: Break down this user registration epic into stories.
say_en.note: Claude will walk you through INVEST checks and pattern matching.

say_en.text: This reporting feature is too large; use splitting patterns.
say_en.note: Claude will apply 9 patterns sequentially until one fits.

say_en.text: Use workflow steps pattern to split the publishing process.
say_en.note: Claude will generate simple end-to-end slice stories.
